dst.text: Panopticon is Memnarch's palace, which Karn puts him in charge of, and where Memnarch straps himself into a serum tank hoping for a vision of Karn, his mind breaking down and his body turning to flesh.
Learning the vedalken are chasing the elf Glissa, he sends Malil to retrieve her, and his plan is revealed: to use the green sun's power and Glissa's spark to become a planeswalker.
Glissa takes out one of Memnarch's legs, but he casts his trademark spell and seizes control of Kaldra, and Bosh steps in front of his friends and is dispatched in seconds.

5dn.text: In the Core, Glissa, Slobad and Bosh confront Memnarch as he channels the plane's mana through the Panopticon, until the green sun's beam strikes it, severely damaging it and maiming Memnarch and Malil, and shattering Memnarch's ascension plans.
Memnarch has Malil mutilate Slobad and takes over his torture to build a means to take Glissa's spark, and later Raksha and Glissa are herded into the Panopticon by Malil clones.
Memnarch emerges cleansed and reveals his ascension web, but Glissa and Memnarch fall off the platform into the mana core.
